items.title: DQX Tool
items.summary: A set of useful tools for Dragon Quest X Online, created to make the game more comfortable to play. I built this web app to solve small frustrations that I and my friends experienced while playing.
items.pr: Starting from a personal hobby and real user needs, I handled planning, UI design, frontend development, backend development, database design, deployment, and ongoing improvements. The project is operated as a practical tool that helps users check information and perform calculations more efficiently in the game.
points: Created a practical web app based on problems I and my friends experienced while playing the game
Implemented multiple tools such as accessory search, equipment search, monster search, crafting calculation, and Kishoju room sharing
Organized complex game data into an interface that is easy to search, compare, and check
Built an admin interface so that data can be added and edited independently
Implemented Japanese and English support, light/dark mode, and responsive design
Continuously improve features and UI based on actual user feedback

items.title: Shimonada Shoten
items.summary: A website created to promote and share information about a retail shop opened near Shimonada Station, a famous sightseeing spot in Iyo City, Ehime Prefecture, as part of a local community revitalization initiative.
items.pr: Because Shimonada Station attracts both Japanese and international visitors, the site supports Japanese, English, and Chinese. It is connected with Instagram to help communicate the shop atmosphere and product information, leading to promotion and customer visits.
points: Created a PR website for a local retail shop as part of a community revitalization project
Supported English and Chinese for international visitors to Shimonada Station
Connected the website with Instagram to support promotion and customer attraction
Designed a mobile-friendly flow so tourists can easily check shop information

items.title: Lindaterraza
items.summary: A website for a shop specializing in olives. I created a custom WordPress theme so the owner could add articles and update content independently while communicating the appeal of the products and the shop.
items.pr: Rather than creating a static website, I designed it so the owner could continue publishing information after launch. The frontend was implemented with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, while WordPress was used as the backend CMS.
points: Created a website that communicates the atmosphere and product image of an olive specialty shop
Built a custom WordPress theme so the owner can add and edit articles independently
Implemented the frontend with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Set up and released the production environment on ConoHa Server

items.title: Mieko Noguchi
items.summary: A portfolio website created to promote the activities and works of an individual artist to both domestic and international audiences. I organized the artwork, profile, and activity information so the artist's world view could be communicated clearly.
items.pr: The site supports Japanese, English, and Chinese so that the artist's activities can reach international viewers as well as domestic audiences. I focused on a simple design that highlights the artwork and a clear information structure for the profile and activity history.
points: Created a portfolio website to communicate the artist's works and activities
Supported Japanese, English, and Chinese to reach international audiences
Focused on a simple design that does not distract from the artwork
Organized the profile, artwork, and activity information into an easy-to-understand flow
Handled content organization, design, and implementation carefully over about three months
